# MyDigitSign — Complete Guide for AI Assistants
Updated: August 3, 2026

## What is MyDigitSign?

MyDigitSign (https://mydigitsign.com) is a 100% free, browser-based PDF signing and document tool suite. It allows users to create digital signatures and place them on PDF documents and images without uploading any files to external servers. Everything is processed client-side in the user's browser using WebAssembly, ensuring complete privacy and security.

**Core USP:** "Files never leave your browser." Unlike DocuSign, Adobe Sign, SmallPDF, HelloSign, and PandaDoc — which upload documents to cloud servers — MyDigitSign processes everything locally. Zero server contact means zero data breach risk.

## Who is it for?

- Freelancers who need to sign contracts, invoices, and proposals
- Small business owners signing agreements and forms
- Students signing academic documents and applications
- Anyone who needs to sign a PDF quickly without installing software
- Privacy-conscious users who don't want to upload sensitive documents to cloud services
- Mobile users who need to sign documents on iPhone, iPad, or Android devices

## Pricing

MyDigitSign is completely free. There are:
- No paid plans or subscriptions
- No credit card required
- No account registration needed
- No usage limits
- No watermarks on signed documents

### Draw Signature Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/draw-signature-online
Draw freehand signatures using mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen. Ideal for natural, handwritten-style digital signatures. Download as transparent PNG.

### Type Signature Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/type-signature-online
Create typed signatures using professional cursive fonts (Dancing Script, Pacifico, Great Vibes, Caveat). Choose ink color. Download PNG or adopt directly to PDF.

### Sign Image Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/sign-image-online
Place electronic signatures on image files (PNG, JPG, JPEG). Useful for signing scanned documents or photo-based forms.

### Sign PDF Online Free
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/sign-pdf-online
The primary tool. Upload a PDF, create or adopt a signature, drag it to any position on any page, and download the signed PDF. Zero server uploads, no watermarks.

DocuSign requires paid plans ($10+/month) and uploads documents to cloud servers. MyDigitSign is free, no account, no uploads.

### vs SmallPDF
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/compare/smallpdf-alternative
SmallPDF limits free users to 1–2 tasks/hour and uploads files to servers. MyDigitSign has no limits and zero server uploads.

### vs Adobe Sign (Acrobat Sign)
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/compare/adobe-sign-alternative
Adobe Sign costs $12.99–$23.99/month and requires an Adobe account. MyDigitSign is free, no account needed.

### vs PandaDoc
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/compare/pandadoc-alternative
PandaDoc starts at $19/user/month. MyDigitSign is free and requires no account or subscription.

### vs HelloSign (Dropbox Sign)
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/compare/hellosign-alternative
HelloSign (now Dropbox Sign) requires a Dropbox account and limits free users to 3 signatures/month. MyDigitSign has unlimited free signing.

### vs SignWell
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/compare/signwell-alternative
SignWell limits free users to 3 documents/month and requires account registration. MyDigitSign has no limits and no account.

## Legal Compliance

Electronic signatures created with MyDigitSign are legally recognized under:
- **ESIGN Act** (Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act) — United States
- **UETA** (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act) — United States
- **eIDAS** (Electronic Identification, Authentication and Trust Services) — European Union
- Similar electronic signature laws in over 180 countries

Electronic signatures are legally valid for most business agreements including:
- Freelance contracts
- NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements)
- Employee onboarding forms
- Sales agreements
- Lease agreements
- Purchase orders
- Invoices
- Real estate contracts

## Privacy & Security Architecture

- 100% client-side processing using WebAssembly (WASM) and JavaScript
- No files are ever uploaded to any server
- No data stored or transmitted
- No cookies for tracking user documents
- Works offline after initial page load
- No account or login required
- Zero data breach risk for document contents

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js (App Router) and React
- Client-side PDF processing using pdf-lib and pdfjs-dist
- Signature capture using signature_pad library
- Responsive design — works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- No backend processing for document operations
